convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for the RangeExpansionIndex indicator and depends on external TradeAlgorithms.mqh library for all trade execution (open/close position functions, money management, global variable cleanup). The custom indicator is not a built-in MT5 indicator.

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars required for indicator calculation
TimeShiftSec - timeframe duration in seconds
derived_values.used_by: Signal time calculation for position open functions

other_exits: Long position closed when REI[1] > Dn_Indicator_level (indicator rises above lower threshold, meaning it was below and now is not, triggering else-branch BUY_Close=true)
Short position closed when REI[1] < Up_Indicator_level (indicator falls below upper threshold, meaning it was above and now is not, triggering else-branch SELL_Close=true)

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MarginMode enum determines sizing method: LOT=fixed lot size (MM=0.1), FREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin, BALANCE=fraction of balance, LOSSFREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin minus loss, LOSSBALANCE=fraction of balance minus loss. Positive MM=fraction-based (percent of margin/balance), interpretation depends on MMMode selector.

custom_logic_notes: Entry logic uses two-bar comparison: Ind[1] is the older bar (SignalBar+1) and Ind[0] is the signal bar (SignalBar). Long entry: REI[1] > lower level AND REI[0] <= lower level (crossunder into oversold). Short entry: REI[1] < upper level AND REI[0] >= upper level (crossover into overbought). Exit via signal reversal: when REI[1] is already beyond the level but the condition fails (else branches), opposite close flags are set. The SignalBar input (default=1) controls which bar is used for signal detection. When SignalBar=0, the EA evaluates on every tick instead of only on new bars. The UpSignalTime/DnSignalTime are computed as last bar datetime + TimeShiftSec and passed to the open position functions, likely for pending order timing or expiration.
python_conversion_notes: The RangeExpansionIndex is a custom indicator with no standard Python equivalent - its formula must be obtained from the indicator source code and reimplemented. The TradeAlgorithms.mqh library handles all order execution, money management, and position management; these functions (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, GlobalVariableDel_, LoadHistory, CIsNewBar) must be reimplemented in Python. The MMMode enum provides 5 different position sizing methods that all need implementation. SL/TP are in points (not pips), so ensure proper point-to-pip conversion accounting for broker digit count. The signal bar shift mechanism (SignalBar parameter) means signals are evaluated on a historical bar, not the current forming bar, which is important for backtesting alignment.
